subject: AI enquiry follow-up for Royal Technosoft
body:
Managing Director,

Royal Technosoft has not raised funding, so the fastest growth lever is converting more of the enquiries you already receive. Your Navrangpura centre has a 4.9/5 Justdial rating across 1,028 reviews, but the visible stack is a login-only Acedmicx portal, website, Wheree listing and social channels, with no CRM evidenced. While you expand to Surat and hire technical trainers, manual follow-up puts enrolled seats at risk.

We help training institutes capture every Justdial call, Instagram DM and walk-in, score intent, and draft a WhatsApp response in minutes. A 6-week pilot can target an 8% to 10%+ enquiry-to-enrolment conversion rate and prove value against a 30-day baseline.

Open to a 30-minute walkthrough using a sample of recent enquiries?

I've attached a one-page summary.

[Your Name]
